technology_name: AN INTERNET OF UNDERWATER THINGS (IoUT)-BASED WATER QUALITY MONITORING SYSTEM AND METHOD OF OPERATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Subsea Wireless Telemetry / Water Quality Monitoring
problem_solved: Standard marine water diagnostic arrays depend on high-maintenance wired probes or localized manual collections that cannot output multi-parameter field data continuously.
description: An Internet of Underwater Things (IoUT) monitoring network comprising a primary floating solar-powered terminal buoy node, specialized subsea multi-parameter optical sensing pods, a localized sonar array, and long-range (LoRa) telemetry links.
applications: Marine sanctuary habitat tracking arrays, offshore aquaculture ocean farm telemetry, maritime harbor chemical monitoring networks, and municipal water reservoir defense arrays.
